decisions.name: createdAt_-1
decisions.reason: Sort removed and fewer documents fetched, but all three target endpoint P95 values were worse than the preserved historical baseline. No demonstrated end-to-end latency benefit on this small dataset; cross-run environment noise prevents causal attribution.

decisions.name: provinceId_1_createdAt_-1
decisions.reason: Initial province-list P95 improved 18.2 percent versus the historical summary, but the focused visibility check did not reproduce a reliable tail-latency benefit: visible P95 36.28 ms versus hidden 30.20 ms. Better plan and fewer document reads alone do not justify KEEP on 384 members; remove the 20 KiB candidate.
